ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering Minnesota's Fraud Epidemic
ideas.description: Investigate the connections between various fraud schemes in Minnesota, including Feeding Our Future and the $90M Medicaid fraud.
questions: What are the connections between these schemes?
How widespread is fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: The AI detective sees a potential web of deceit across Minnesota, with multiple large-scale fraud schemes. Investigating these connections could uncover a larger fraud epidemic.
